purpose: Portable, inspectable behavioral contract. Does not include credentials, executable source, personal recordings, or private user data.

rules: don't answer background speech as a question

stages: select project angle and avoid repeats
set audience depth and length target
stream OpenRouter primary and approved fallback
repair wording with original perfACT voice rules
rules: never add a second live model call solely to polish
keep raw and revised transcript distinct
do not turn uncertain audio into invented assertions

stages: derive nine audience tiers without model calls
deterministic transcript review and practice metrics
optional LLM feedback on user request
rules: never conflate rehearsal with verified experience
keep strong technical details for engineers
business ownership and tradeoffs for directors
prefer natural language at all levels

exportFormats.rawBrowser: kompas-data v1 with optional marketfit extension (backward compatible)
exportFormats.curatedBlend: kompas-blend v1, includes server dossier and portable browser context
exportFormats.engineContract: kompas-engine-policy v2, version/checksum validation only; never execute imported JSON as code

browserTransfer.perfactStorage: perfact.* except live heartbeat, cross-address theme, connect-app choice
browserTransfer.merge: add missing IDs/keys; preserve current entries; backup destination before import
browserTransfer.privacy: user download only for local archive; authenticated dossier upload requires explicit import; never include auth tokens

performance.liveAnswer: streamed Server-Sent Events where model supports streaming; deterministic checks inline; no network call for model-free scoring routes
performance.speech: audio uploads are bounded and time-limited, with language-aware Whisper model selection
performance.claim: no guaranteed zero latency; report real p50/p95 and errors after authenticated load testing

preservedUnmerged.privateSource: The standalone perfACT repository is private and cannot be erased until a separate private full source backup is confirmed.
additionalSystems: legacy cloud worker transcription and state
preservedUnmerged.status: audit and explicit decisions required; no silent removal or false full-merge claim
